title: Aprende a bailar Marinera Norteña en pareja | Coreografía final

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher uses a voiceover to narrate the choreography while performing it in real-time with a partner. She focuses on the sequence of figures and the interaction between the couple, using hula hoops as spatial markers.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces herself and the guest partner.
The teacher performs the choreography while narrating each step and figure.
Full performance of the choreography with music and no voiceover.

steps_taught.name: Saludo
steps_taught.description: Approaching the center to greet the partner with the handkerchief.

steps_taught.name: Vuelta y contravuelta
steps_taught.description: A full turn followed by a turn in the opposite direction.

steps_taught.name: El ocho
steps_taught.description: Moving in a figure-eight pattern around the partner.

steps_taught.name: Hombro con hombro
steps_taught.description: Approaching the partner until shoulders are aligned, then switching sides.

steps_taught.name: Fuga
steps_taught.description: Energetic footwork sequence with handkerchief waving.

steps_taught.name: Remate
steps_taught.description: Final sequence leading to the closing pose.

what_works: The use of hula hoops on the floor clearly defines the starting and ending points for each figure.
The voiceover provides immediate context for the movements being shown.
what_hinders: The teacher does not break down the footwork mechanics in this specific video, assuming prior knowledge of basic steps.
The fast pace of the narration might be difficult for absolute beginners to follow.

quotes.text: Empezamos nuestra estructura coreográfica básica con la posición inicial de baile.
Espero moviendo la cadera las chicas y los caballeros marchando.
Me preparo para realizar el ocho.
Hago una pausa con un giro, los chicos se arrodillan.

evidence_segments.observation: The couple starts in separate hoops, moves to the center for a handkerchief salute, and returns.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact weight distribution during the salute

evidence_segments.observation: The dancers perform a turn and counter-turn followed by a pose with handkerchiefs high.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: specific finger grip on the handkerchief

evidence_segments.observation: The dancers trace a figure-eight path around each other, crossing in the middle.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: footwork details under the long skirt

evidence_segments.observation: Side-to-side semi-circular movements (media luna) with rhythmic steps.
The couple performs 'hombro con hombro', passing each other closely while looking over the shoulder.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: subtle facial expressions due to distance

evidence_segments.observation: Final footwork sequence (remate) ending with the man kneeling or posing behind the woman.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact count of the final stamps

extraction.distinctive_method: The use of physical hula hoops on the floor to teach spatial awareness and 'home' positions in a partner dance.
